_comment: Rule 3: every asset shipped from this app says where it came from and under what terms. Checked by scripts/check-asset-licenses.mjs, which requires source, licence and author on every entry. Paths are relative to this file.
_fonts: All three families are variable fonts. The files here were fetched from the Google Fonts CSS2 API with the weight axis clipped to the range this site actually sets (wght@500..700 and wght@400..700), which is why one file covers every weight of a family instead of one file per weight. Each family is split into the 'latin' and 'latin-ext' subsets Google publishes, so a browser downloads only the subset the page needs. The bytes are Google's own subsetted, hinted builds, redistributed unmodified under the OFL; the licence text is in src/styles/fonts/OFL.txt.

_icons: The five app icons are drawn by scripts/make-icons.mjs — arithmetic in that file, no design tool and no third-party artwork — from the geometry of src/components/Wordmark.tsx. Re-run `node scripts/make-icons.mjs` to reproduce them byte for byte. The one departure from the wordmark is that the second seat is a ring rather than a disc, so the two seats stay distinguishable in greyscale (rule 7).
